PLAY · WHAT LIGHT DOES

Fox’s Rainbow Light Lab

Light makes amazing pictures! Tap a light clue, then tap the picture it makes.

Tap a light clue, then tap the picture it makes.

Light solved!

A prism bends light into a rainbow, a flashlight casts a bright circle, and sunlight paints a shadow.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Three genuine light phenomena in one game. Try them at home: a CD or glass of water makes rainbows, a torch makes shadow puppets — the say-lines set up the experiments.

Prefer paper? The Fox’s Rainbow Light Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
